Spoiler:
Coding stuff
v
With Electron
Download or Clone the repo
Open command prompt and cd to the folder containing package.json ( not the package.json inside the app folder! )
Install the dependencies by using the cli
npm install
Run the app with electron by using the cli
npm start
Building​
Two Scripts are included to build:
build-64 and build-32 will build for Windows 64bit and 32bit
To use, run the cli
npm run build-64 or npm run build-32
( That's assuming you're in the package.json directory, if not cd to that directory )

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
So, 1:
How the heck did you even find out this is a plugin you want? I've been trying to figure out what exactly QMap is, but all the main sources just say how to download it/install it but with no other description as to what the thing is. From what I could gather at a very brief scan off the help documentation of the original QMap (not the Luna port) is that it is just a more advanced map editor.
Which brings me to point 2:
Have you considered TileD? It is still being supported because it acts more as a middleware app for map designing for many engines. There is a TileD integration plugin for MV and MZ.
Tiled Map Editor by Thorbjørn Lindeijer
Free, easy to use and flexible level editor.
thorbjorn.itch.io
RPG Maker integration:
Tiled Plugin for RPG Maker MZ by VisuStella, VisuStellaMZ, Archeia
Allows you to use maps made in Tiled for RPG Maker MZ
visustella.itch.io
always read the installation instructions thoroughly.
